messages:
anya: onboarding holliday14b (int4) canary -> seeing OOMs under sustained small-batch traffic. batch=6, max_output_tokens=768.

pat: can you paste the error and whether its coldstart or after warmup?

anya: steady-state. log snippet:
```
2024-04-10T11:12:05Z ERROR serve: CUDA OOM allocating 980MiB for KV cache
context: gen_step 2780, seq=3072 -> req max_output_tokens=768, batch=6
```

lee: int4 kernels + batch=6 could be causing slab fragmentation. did we try warmslot priming?

anya: not yet. repro locally: batch=3 + warmslot=true passes, batch=6 fails after ~5 requests.

pat: quick mitigation: set warmslot_size=2, warmslot_priming=true, disable prefetch, reduce kv_prune_threshold to 0.1. Also lower default batch by ~30% for canary.

anya: applied warmslot_size=2 + prefetch=false; node stayed up for 30min under test traffic. slight p99 latency increase.

lee: sounds fragmentation-related. followups: run 1h A/B (int4-warmslot vs int8) and capture fallback rate and per-request peak alloc. add fallback_policy -> int8 if slab_free_gap>80%.

infra-bot: deploy finished for service=holliday14b-canary by anya at 2024-04-10T11:36:20Z.
